dedupe_keys.name: vantor formerly maxar worldview satellite imagery tasking and vivid 2d and 3d global basemaps

description: Vantor, the company formerly called Maxar (maxar.com now redirects to vantor.com), operates the WorldView imaging satellite constellation and sells tasked imagery, global basemaps and 3D terrain, mainly to defence, intelligence, mapping and commercial asset monitoring users. Coverage: global; WorldView tasking offers 30 cm resolution optical imagery with what Vantor calls more collection capacity at that resolution than any other commercial offering, plus WorldView Radar for 24/7 all-weather collection, for mapping and for monitoring energy infrastructure, construction projects and environmental change; the Vivid products are global 2D mosaics and features kept current by AI change detection; Vivid Terrain gives 3D surface models at 50 cm resolution with real colours and textures for over 95 percent of the world's highest-interest areas, stated as accurate to within 3 m in all dimensions. Format and access: tasking and product orders through Vantor's spatial intelligence platform (Hub, Forge, Cortex, Nexus), with datasheets on request; commercial. Licence: commercial terms under Vantor's legal pages, not read. Caveats: prices, archive depth and file formats were not read; much of the product line targets defence users. Simulation uses: very high resolution imagery and 3D terrain to map and update infrastructure assets, assess disaster damage for emergency response, and build city and site digital twins. Related records: Ecopia AI vector maps (data-ecopia-ai-vector-maps-buildings-land-cover-transport), which partners with Vantor for 3D mapping, and Nearmap aerial imagery (data-nearmap-aerial-imagery-and-ai-layers).
